column1: # comment: "Name alignments for comprehensive, multi-culture interop \u2014 schema.org, vCard 4 (N components, nickname, fn), GEDCOM X (gx:) name parts, FOAF, and a few well-established Wikidata properties. Multi-cultural name-part KINDS (gmeow:NamePartType value individuals such as namePartGiven/namePartSurname) align closeMatch to the nearest external concept, following the places.ttl idiom; there are no flat given/family name properties \u2014 a 'First Last' rendering is produced by downcasting the structured gmeow:NamePart model in the projection layer (projections/*). The PronounSet CLASS and the hasPronounSet PROPERTY now align (closeMatch) to Wikidata's 'personal pronoun set' (Q65067284) and 'personal pronoun' (P6553) \u2014 verified live against the Wikidata API \u2014 whose Sept-2025 RfC calls for full-declension pronoun sets (each set's forms, not a single lexeme) \u2014 aligning with GMEOW's reified five-form English model; the per-set declensions, NameRegister, NameUsage and the inclusivity machinery (displayable, namePurposeChosen/Deadname) remain CANONICAL \u2014 no maintained external RDF vocabulary declines individual sets faithfully (the pronoun ANCHOR list is sourced from the pronouns.page structured database, cited in names.ttl + docs/identity-mapping.md). Co-equality of multilingual names is a structural stance, not an external mapping. Coreference of name INSTANCES is done in data, not here."
